items.title: Eurreal Wilford "Little Brother" Montgomery Interview, 1958-05-29
items.q: In fact, I think Lil did finally come into the band after I cut out

ctx.x: I think you said Lil had the Hawker jewelry to keep things going or something.

Yeah, maybe. Some story. In fact, I think Lil did finally come into the band after I cut out and then Earl cut out and they still tried to carry on. So what happened, the people didn't come out, didn't support it. I remember what really topped off everything. He gave a dance free at Warwick Hall, you know. He said, well I just want to see if we can do it. Let's come on in, it's for free, no animation done. Let's come on in. He didn't expect to make anything. So we couldn't have a crowd for free, you know. They…
He was a drummer. From the old school Bixen, Benny Goodman, and all of them.
